model.description: Bare Anthropic model id for the Claude Agent SDK (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5'). NOT the 'provider:model' ROS form. Blank = the CLI's default.

system_prompt.description: Extra system prompt appended to Claude Code's own agent prompt.

workspace.description: Absolute working directory the agent operates in (reads/edits/shell). Blank = ROS_CLAUDE_CODE_WORKSPACE env, else a per-run temp dir.

permission_mode.description: How the agent handles tool/edit permission prompts. Autonomous runs use 'acceptEdits'; 'plan' is read-only planning.

max_turns.description: Hard cap on the agent-loop turns so a run can't loop forever.

allowed_tools.description: Allow-list of tool names the agent may use (e.g. 'Read', 'Edit', 'Bash'). Omit to allow the CLI defaults.

disallowed_tools.description: Deny-list of tool names to withhold from the agent.

setting_sources.description: Which on-disk settings & CLAUDE.md the CLI loads. Omit for a hermetic run (loads none).
